hero.sub: Eye of Providence measures how much you write yourself, how much your AI writes for you, and where the rest of your time goes — across IDE, terminal, and browser. Local-first. Open source. No code ever leaves your machine.

measure.sub: Five categories, one timeline. Eye of Providence reconstructs the lineage of every line saved — whether you typed it, accepted an inline suggestion, or watched an agent write it for you.

cards.title: Activity & focus
cards.body: Active time, idle, AFK, and uninterrupted focus sessions per app and per project. Idle threshold 60–120 s, fully tunable.

cards.title: Coding time
cards.body: Manual coding, AI-assisted coding, and review/reading time — split per file, per language, per project.

cards.title: AI usage breakdown
cards.body: By provider, channel, and interaction type. Detect chat, autocomplete, agents, and edits across browser, IDE, and CLI.

cards.title: Code provenance
cards.body: Every diff classified: typed · pasted-AI · pasted-other · AI-inline · AI-agent. Conservative, with a visible 'unknown' bucket.

cards.title: Live dashboards
cards.body: Heatmaps, AI-ratio trends, per-language splits, dependency score. Read-only local preview before anything syncs.

cards.title: Narrative reports
cards.body: Weekly digests written by Gemini from aggregated numbers only — never code, never prompts. Opt-in. Local Ollama fallback.

how.title: Four quiet pieces. One picture.
how.sub: A lightweight agent watches the OS, your browser, and your editor. Everything else is just math.
how.heading: Four quiet pieces. One picture.

items.title: Observe
items.desc: 5–15 MB Tauri agent samples focus, idle, and keystroke counts via NSWorkspace / WinEventHook. No content captured.

items.title: Categorize
items.desc: Browser extension flags AI sites. IDE plugin sees inline accepts. Claude Code hooks fire on every agent edit.

items.title: Attribute
items.desc: Diff hunks per save are matched to keystroke ranges, paste events, and clipboard provenance. The rest stays 'unknown'.

items.title: Synthesize
items.desc: ClickHouse aggregates feed a personal dashboard, and — opt-in — a weekly narrative report from Gemini.

attribution.sub: Every hunk that lands in your editor gets a tag. We err on the side of 'unknown' — better to admit ignorance than to mislabel a line you wrote yourself.

privacy.sub: Eye of Providence is a measurement tool, not a surveillance system. The agent is open source. The backend is self-hostable. Your code never travels.

principles.body: All processing happens on your device. Only aggregated metadata leaves it.
File contents, prompts, AI responses, raw keystrokes, clipboard payloads, private-window titles.
Agent and extension code is fully public. Self-host the backend if you want zero external dependencies.
Admins see aggregates only, with k-anonymity ≥ 5. No per-session view. Every read is audit-logged.
Erases your data from ClickHouse, Postgres, and S3 in a single action. GDPR-ready.
